question: Is Get_IsUnsupportedSystem.Out_IsUnsupportedSystem exactly (unsupported app version OR WebView version OR browser version), i.e. the OR of the three outputs of Get_IsUnsupportedVersion that the shared UnsupportedVersion_Wrapper uses? question: What does UBT_AppManager DelayedMessage_Show do (Login OnReady, when CallbackType is not DeviceAwareness_InvalidDevice), and who sets the client variable AppManager_DelayedMessage? Neither is ported in the shell (CR-Login-1).
mcp: not available to the route agent (UBT_AppManager.controller not in the route sources)
answer: DelayedMessage_Show (UBT_AppManager.controller.js): if AppManager_DelayedMessage is not empty, JSON-deserialize it (AppManager_DelayedMessage record: MessageTitle, Message, Type), set the variable to "", then FeedbackMessage_AutoClose(title, message, type, EncodedHTML=True, ExtendedClass="", DelayMs=0, UseDebounce=False). The only writer is DelayedMessage_Define, called only by FRD_HandleEvent_Logout (Firebase Realtime Database remote logout: AppManager_Logout, DelayedMessage_Define, JSUtils_PageRefresh). The mock has no Firebase, so the message is never set; port DelayedMessage_Show as a shell function (CR-Login-1).
